content:
The role

Design and ship security automation for our detection platform. You will own Kafka-based telemetry pipelines and build enrichment services in Python.

  • Ship Python microservices that enrich alerts with threat intelligence
  • Maintain Elasticsearch clusters used by the hunting team
  • Review Sigma and YARA content in CI before it reaches production

Must have

  • 4+ years of experience building security tooling
  • Deep Python experience; familiarity with Kafka and Elasticsearch
  • Comfort with Linux, Docker and Git-based workflows

Compensation

€70k-€90k depending on location and experience. Remote within the EU.
title: Security Automation Engineer
